name_zh: 拉赫曼：语言民族主义/世俗建国/解放战争/谢赫精神/孟加拉身份
name_en: Rahman: Language Nationalism/Secular Nation-Building/Liberation War/Sheikh Spirit/Bangladeshi Identity
description_zh: 拉赫曼是孟加拉国的国父，1903-1975年，他领导孟加拉国人民争取独立。拉赫曼推动了语言民族主义运动，领导了孟加拉语解放运动。拉赫曼推动了世俗建国，领导了孟加拉国解放战争，建立了独立国家。他倡导谢赫精神，强调文明多样性和宗教和谐。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想为孟加拉国独立和现代化奠定了基础。
description_en: Rahman was the father of Bangladesh from 1903 to 1975, who led the Bangladeshi people to fight for independence. Rahman promoted language nationalism and led the Bengali language liberation movement. Rahman promoted secular nation-building and led the Bangladesh Liberation War, establishing an independent country. He advocated Sheikh spirit and emphasized civilizational diversity and religious harmony. His leadership art and nationalist thought laid the foundation for Bangladesh's independence and modernization.
reason_zh: 拉赫曼领导孟加拉国人民赢得独立，建立了独立国家，推动了语言民族主义和世俗建国。他的谢赫精神倡导文明多样性和宗教和谐，但他的领导艺术和民族主义思想也引发了宗教冲突。他的政治遗产至今仍充满争议。
reason_en: Rahman led the Bangladeshi people to win independence and establish an independent country, promoting language nationalism and secular nation-building. His Sheikh spirit advocated civilizational diversity and religious harmony, but his leadership art and nationalist thought also sparked religious conflicts. His political legacy remains highly controversial today.
steps_zh: 学习拉赫曼的领导艺术和民族主义思想，理解在殖民时代国家建国的历史必然性
研究孟加拉语解放运动的历史背景和过程，掌握语言民族主义的外交策略
分析孟加拉国解放战争的背景和过程，掌握在殖民时代国家建国的外交策略
探讨拉赫曼的谢赫精神和文明多样性，理解在多宗教环境下推行和谐的必要性
总结拉赫曼的经验教训，阐述在殖民时代国家建国的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Rahman’s leadership art and nationalist thought, understand the historical inevitability of national independence during colonial times
Study the historical background and process of the Bengali language liberation movement, master diplomatic strategies for language nationalism
Study the background and process of the Bangladesh Liberation War, master diplomatic strategies for national independence during colonial times
Explore Rahman’s Sheikh spirit and civilizational diversity, understand the necessity of promoting harmony in multi-religious environments
Summarize Rahman’s experiences and the challenges of national independence during colonial times
expected_zh: 掌握拉赫曼的领导艺术和民族主义思想，熟悉孟加拉语解放运动和孟加拉国解放战争的历史背景，理解谢赫精神和文明多样性的重要性，培养学生对在殖民时代国家建国的理解和认识。
expected_en: Master Rahman’s leadership art and nationalist thought, be familiar with the historical background of the Bengali language liberation movement and Bangladesh Liberation War, understand the importance of Sheikh spirit and civilizational diversity, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of national independence during colonial times.
case_zh: 1952年，拉赫曼领导孟加拉人民开展了语言革命，要求使用孟加拉语进行官方文件和教育。1956年，拉赫曼领导孟加拉国人民赢得独立，建立了孟加拉国。他倡导谢赫精神，强调文明多样性和宗教和谐。他的领导艺术和民族主义思想为孟加拉国独立和现代化奠定了基础。
case_en: In 1952, Rahman led the Bengali people to launch the language revolution, demanding the use of Bengali for official documents and education. In 1956, Rahman led the Bangladeshi people to win independence and establish Bangladesh. He advocated Sheikh spirit and emphasized civilizational diversity and religious harmony. His leadership art and nationalist thought laid the foundation for Bangladesh's independence and modernization.
cross_cultural_impact: Language nationalism movement, liberation war model, civilizational diversity advocacy
